name: Archibald Morton
role: South Heart man whose horses were stolen in 1884
bio: Archibald Morton of South Heart had four horses stolen from his barn in July 1884. Henry Scott and Clay Layton were arrested for the theft in August 1884 and escaped from the Dickinson jail that September.
